pages.title: Quest checks
pages.text:
**Goal:** unstick one blocked task without rebuilding the pad.\
You need the quest screen, JEI, and (for Tribal) the **Spirit Codex**.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read the exact task and its prerequisites. Check item counts, variants and whether the task wants possession, crafting or another action. Click the quest item to open JEI. Try the task's detect button when one is available.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Check rewards too: an unclaimed token cannot be seated. If Claw is stuck on plans, craft the Blueprint Package from four Blueprint Paper. If playing together, confirm you are in the intended Clowder before repeating a long crafting chain.

pages.title: Machine checks
pages.text:
Check these separately:\
1\. Correct input and recipe.\
2\. Available power and range.\
3\. Required totem or other structure.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
4\. Space for the result.\
5\. Pausing redstone and side settings.\
For Tribal Power, crouch and right-click the machine with the Spirit Codex. Test one machine before connecting a whole production line.

pages.title: Shared lives
pages.text: When shared lives are on (default), each Clowder mate adds **three** lives to one team pool. A survival death spends one. Food and potions do not put it back. At zero, affected players become spectators.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: `/skybound lives` prints the pool. Six quest rewards named **Thread of Return** each add one life when claimed. There is no item to use. Operators run `/skybound revive`. Plan trips together.

pages.title: Common traps
pages.text:
A Sky Stone Tank that you just moved is empty unless you bucketed first. Use a Spirit Cistern to carry liquids.\
Pad-runners are in the March, not on the pad. After the Gate, Esther waits at `/clowder hub`.\
**Check:** you have isolated one cause from this page, not rebuilt the whole workshop on a guess.
